## How the agents are kept trustworthy

- Less access than the person served: The builder holds less access to the chief executive's assistant than the chief executive does, proven on a ten case privacy test before it was applied, on the principal's explicit go [DONE; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
- Review before release: Three consecutive internal releases halted on an independent reviewer's objection while their own tests were passing [DONE; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
- Self modification blocked: Audited an AI system's forty item plan to upgrade itself and blocked it, documenting eleven serious defects. Rule written: no system turns its own self assessment into a change to its behavior [DONE; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
- Someone is on call: The chief executive's assistant went down overnight and was back with its full history in nine hours, after the first passing test was rejected as a false green. Every leader's machine now has independent monitoring [RUNNING; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
- The approval rule: Agents read and prepare freely. Anything that leaves the company waits for a person to approve the exact draft; if the draft changes, the approval is gone [RUNNING; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
- Providers certified: Ten AI and data providers checked against a training and retention standard from primary vendor terms; one that trains on customer data by default was caught before any content reached it [DONE; Provider terms review, ten providers; measured 2026-09-19]
- Paid memory service removed: Removed after proving nothing read from it; every usable fact migrated first with source level checks [DONE; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
- No rounding up: An unresolved outage written up as unresolved; a delivery note that opened with its own ten defects [DONE; Per leader agent deployment logs, measured 2026-09-20; measured 2026-09-19]
